**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

This is a charming beginning. I shall be delighted to have it next Christmas and if possible will put the chapters in together, so as to have all in one vol.[^2] With many thanks

C M Yonge

[^1]: Card printed on one side ‘Foreign post card’ addressed to ‘Italy/ Signora Linda Villari/ 932 Via Pinti/ Florence/Italia’ and postmarked Winchester 3 March 1879.

[^2]: Linda Villari, \'The Angel of Viareggio: A Tale of Child-Life in Italy\' began in MP ns 31 (January 1880) and ran until July.
